label: Orders in pending cases
caption: M & K EMPLOYEE SOLUTIONS, ET AL. V. TRUSTEES OF THE IAM PENSION
text: The order granting the petition for a writ of certiorari is amended as follows. The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted limited to the following question: Whether 29 U. S. C. §1391’s instruction to compute withdrawal liability “as of the end of the plan year” requires the plan to base the computation on the actuarial assumptions most recently adopted before the end of the year, or allows the plan to use different actuarial assumptions that were adopted after, but based on information available as of, the end of the year.
